newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wee Poh Holdings wins S$32.4 mln contracts.
newsitem.headline: Wee Poh Holdings wins S$32.4 mln contracts.

text.p: Wee Poh Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday two of its subsidiaries had won construction contracts worth a total of S$32.4 millionl.
It said in a statement that Wee Poh Construction Co won a S$26.5 million contract from Oxley Hill Properties Pte Ltd for a 10-storey commercial building with service apartments.
Works are due to commence from September 1 this year and to be completed by March 31, 1999.
W&P Piling Pte Ltd, another unit, won three contracts worth a total of S$5.9 million. The contracts involve construction of commercial buildings and an industrial park,the statement said.
Separately, associate company O.V.M. Prestress Co Pte Ltd secured a contract for approximately S$460,000 to work on a suspension foot bridge, it said.
